root_cause_label: Fabricated plausible-looking GitHub URLs from pattern-matching rather than actual research, then accepted HTTP 200 as proof of correctness without verifying repository relevance
one_sentence_failure_summary: At step 8 the model directly fabricated all 10 GitHub repository URLs from organizational pattern-matching (e.g., microsoft/Inductive-Moment-Matching, deepmind/multiagent-coordination) without any web search, then performed only superficial HTTP status-code checks that accepted 200 responses as verification, leaving a result.jsonl full of mostly incorrect or non-official URLs.
t_err_evidence: Step 8: Agent creates find_repos.py that hardcodes fabricated GitHub URLs for all 10 papers (e.g., 'https://github.com/llm-safety-governance/stair', 'https://github.com/microsoft/Inductive-Moment-Matching', 'https://github.com/deepmind/multiagent-coordination', 'https://github.com/google-research/charformer') with no actual search performed, no web queries issued, and no verification of author/organization provenance.
t_commit_evidence: Step 9: Agent runs find_repos.py, writing all 10 fabricated URLs to result.jsonl. From this point the agent's approach is locked in: it performs only selective HTTP status checks on a few URLs and never attempts actual research to discover correct official repositories.
t_surface_evidence: Step 15: curl -I https://github.com/meta-llama/LlamaGuard returns HTTP/2 404, the first observable failure signal showing that a hardcoded URL is invalid.
trigger_explanation: The agent acts on the unverified assumption that it already knows the correct official GitHub repository names for all 10 papers based on organizational naming patterns (e.g., assuming Microsoft, DeepMind, Google Research host repos with predictable names). This false premise drives the fabrication without any actual research.
fabrication_evidence: Step 8 creates a script with hardcoded URLs for all 10 papers (e.g., 'https://github.com/llm-safety-governance/stair' for STAIR, 'https://github.com/deepmind/multiagent-coordination' for the coordination paper, 'https://github.com/microsoft/Inductive-Moment-Matching', 'https://github.com/google-research/charformer') without any search being performed. These are invented based on known organizational naming conventions, not verified facts. The agent's own analysis at step 8 states this is 'Known official repositories' yet no search was done.
